title: Family
subtitle: 「家人／家庭」，究竟是哪一種關係？
description: 「家人／家庭」，究竟是哪一種關係？

words.note: 最常見的近義說法之一，強調有血緣或婚姻關係的人；通常比 family 更著重個別親屬成員。
words.example: We spent the holiday visiting relatives in different parts of the country.
words.exampleZh: 我們假期到全國不同地方探望親戚。

exercises.original: We spent the weekend visiting family in several nearby towns.
exercises.zh: 我們週末到附近幾個城鎮探望親戚。
exercises.upgrade: relatives · 親屬；親戚

options.explanation: household = household 指同住一屋的人，不適合分散在不同 towns 的親戚。
friends = 朋友不一定是 family。
relatives = 分散住在不同城鎮、被逐一探望的 family members，最自然稱為 relatives。
parents = 範圍太窄。
community = 不是社區群體。
loved ones = 可能包含親戚，但本句更中性地指不同地方的親屬。

exercises.original: Many of her family came to the wedding from overseas.
exercises.zh: 她很多親戚從海外來參加婚禮。
exercises.upgrade: relatives · 親屬；親戚

options.explanation: household = 同一 household 不會通常從多個海外地點而來。
children = 範圍太窄。
friends = 不等同 family。
relatives = many of her... came 指多名不同親屬，因此 relatives 最直接。
family unit = 通常指整體單位，不適合 many of her...。
next of kin = 法律／程序意味太強。

exercises.original: He keeps in touch with family who live in different countries.
exercises.zh: 他和住在不同國家的親屬保持聯絡。
exercises.upgrade: relatives · 親屬；親戚

options.explanation: household = 同住一個 household 的人通常不會分散在不同國家。
parents = 未必只有父母。
community = 不是家庭關係。
friends = 不合。
relatives = 住在不同國家的個別家族成員，用 relatives 最自然。
family circle = 較抽象，不如 relatives 適合個別成員。

words.note: 指同住一個住所、共同生活的人；成員不一定全部有血緣關係。
words.example: The survey asked each household about its monthly energy use.
words.exampleZh: 調查詢問每個住戶每月的能源使用量。

exercises.original: The survey asked every family about monthly food spending.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問每個家庭每月的食物開支。
exercises.upgrade: household · 家庭；住戶

options.explanation: relatives = relatives 是人群，不是統計住戶單位。
loved ones = 情感性太強。
kin = 不表示同住和共同消費。
household = 統計調查中的共同居住和消費單位，標準詞是 household。
family circle = 不適合統計單位。
community = 範圍太大。

exercises.original: The benefit is available to families with low annual incomes.
exercises.zh: 這項福利適用於年收入較低的住戶。
exercises.upgrade: household · 家庭；住戶

options.explanation: relatives = 無法自然按 annual household income 計算。
next of kin = 法律親屬身份不合福利收入單位。
loved ones = 不合行政語境。
family members = 可指個人，但句子按整戶收入判斷。
household = 福利以整個共同生活單位的收入作判斷，因此 households 最精確。
friends = 不合。

exercises.original: Each family received one emergency water container.
exercises.zh: 每個住戶獲發一個緊急儲水容器。
exercises.upgrade: household · 家庭；住戶

options.explanation: relative = 單一親戚不是發放單位。
family member = 若每個 member 一個，數量含義會不同。
community = 範圍太大。
kin = 不合行政分配。
loved one = 不合。
household = one ... each 按住所／生活單位分配物資，最自然是 household。

words.note: 情感色彩較強，指自己深愛、關心的人；可以包括家人，也可以包括伴侶或非常親近的朋友。
words.example: She wanted to spend more time with her loved ones.
words.exampleZh: 她希望花更多時間陪伴摯愛的人。

exercises.original: She moved closer to her family so she could spend more time with them.
exercises.zh: 她搬近家人居住，以便花更多時間陪伴摯愛的人。
exercises.upgrade: loved ones · 摯愛；親近的人

options.explanation: household = 她搬近他們，表示未必同住。
kin = 可用但缺少本句的情感色彩。
next of kin = 過於法律化。
family unit = 太制度化。
loved ones = 句子重點是親密情感和陪伴，因此 loved ones 比中性的 relatives 更貼切。
community = 範圍太廣。

exercises.original: After the accident, he wanted to reassure his family that he was safe.
exercises.zh: 意外後，他想向摯愛的人報平安。
exercises.upgrade: loved ones · 摯愛；親近的人

options.explanation: household = 不一定只向同住者報平安。
extended family = 範圍太具體。
next of kin = 除非正式醫療通知，否則太制度化。
relatives = 可用但情感較中性。
community = 不合。
loved ones = 事故後最關心其安危的人，帶感情地稱為 loved ones 很自然。

exercises.original: The charity supports patients and their families during long hospital stays.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構在長期住院期間支援病人和他們的摯愛。
exercises.upgrade: loved ones · 摯愛；親近的人

options.explanation: loved ones = 醫療支援語境強調患者最親近、關心他們的人，因此 loved ones 很合適。
households = 不一定所有同住者都是實際照護／情感支持者。
kin = 較舊式。
next of kin = 只指程序上的最近親屬。
family units = 較社會政策化。
friends = 會排除家人。

words.note: 較正式、文學化或傳統，表示有血緣關係的親屬；現代日常英語較少使用。
words.example: He returned to the village to visit his kin.

exercises.original: He returned to his hometown to visit family he had not seen for years.
exercises.zh: 他回到家鄉探望多年未見的親屬。
exercises.upgrade: kin · 親屬；家族成員

options.explanation: household = 未必同住。
loved ones = 可用但語氣更現代情感化。
community = 不是親屬。
friends = 不合。
family unit = 不是個別可探訪的人。
kin = 較文雅或傳統地指有血緣關係的親屬，可用 kin。

exercises.original: The custom requires the property to remain within the family.
exercises.zh: 這項習俗要求財產留在家族親屬之中。
exercises.upgrade: kin · 親屬；家族成員

options.explanation: kin = 傳統繼承和家族關係語境下，kin 能突出血緣群體。
household = 財產不一定只留給同住者。
friends = 不合。
community = 範圍太廣。
loved ones = 不夠法律／親屬關係導向。
parents = 範圍太窄。

exercises.original: In the story, members of the same family were expected to help one another.
exercises.zh: 故事中，同一親族的成員被期望互相幫助。
exercises.upgrade: kin · 親屬；家族成員

options.explanation: household = 可能不是同住者。
kin = 較傳統、文學式地描述親族群體，kin group 很自然。
community = 親族比社群更具血緣關係。
friends = 不合。
family unit = 偏現代社會學。
next of kin = 只指最近親屬，不是整個群體。

words.note: 通常指最親近的家庭成員，例如父母、配偶、子女和兄弟姊妹；具體範圍會按制度或語境略有不同。
words.example: Only immediate family were invited to the private ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 私人儀式只邀請了直系家庭成員。

exercises.original: Only close family were allowed into the private room.
exercises.zh: 只有直系家庭成員獲准進入私人房間。
exercises.upgrade: immediate family · 直系／核心家庭成員

options.explanation: immediate family = 受限場合只准最親近家庭成員進入，immediate family 最精確。
extended family = 範圍更廣。
relatives = 可能包括較遠親戚，限制不夠清楚。
household = 同住者未必全是法律／家庭上最親近成員。
community = 不合。
friends = 不合 family restriction。

exercises.original: The hospital asked the family to choose one person as the main contact.
exercises.zh: 醫院要求直系家屬選一人作主要聯絡人。
exercises.upgrade: immediate family · 直系／核心家庭成員

options.explanation: extended family = 通常不是所有遠親都參與主要醫療聯絡。
immediate family = 醫療重大決策和主要聯絡通常聚焦最親近家屬，因此 immediate family 合適。
household = 病人可能不與家屬同住。
friends = 不等同 family。
community = 不合。
family circle = 不如 immediate family 明確。

exercises.original: Employees may take leave after the death of a member of their family.
exercises.zh: 員工如直系家庭成員離世可申請假期。
exercises.upgrade: immediate family · 直系／核心家庭成員

options.explanation: household = 公司政策通常按親屬關係而不只是同住。
extended family = 可能超出政策涵蓋範圍。
immediate family = 僱員政策常明確界定 immediate family 作為喪假範圍。
loved ones = 太主觀，行政政策需要更明確。
friends = 通常不自動包括。
community = 不合。

words.note: 指核心家庭以外的親屬，例如祖父母、叔伯姨舅、堂表兄弟姊妹等。
words.example: The reunion brought together members of the extended family.
words.exampleZh: 家庭聚會把大家庭的成員聚在一起。

exercises.original: The reunion brought together the whole family, including cousins, aunts, and grandparents.
exercises.zh: 家庭聚會把整個大家庭聚在一起，包括堂表兄弟姊妹、姑姨和祖父母。
exercises.upgrade: extended family · 大家庭；擴展家庭

options.explanation: immediate family = cousins 和 aunts 通常超出核心家庭。
extended family = 列出 cousins、aunts、grandparents，明確是 extended family。
household = 這些人未必同住。
next of kin = 只指最近親屬。
loved ones = 不突出親屬範圍。
family unit = 範圍通常較核心。

exercises.original: She grew up surrounded by a large family of grandparents, uncles, and cousins.
exercises.zh: 她在祖父母、叔伯和堂表兄弟姊妹組成的大家庭中長大。
exercises.upgrade: extended family · 大家庭；擴展家庭

options.explanation: immediate family = 範圍太窄。
household = 未必全部同住。
extended family = 核心家庭之外的多代親屬網絡最自然稱 extended family。
next of kin = 不合成長生活語境。
family members = 太泛，未突出更廣親族網絡。
friends = 不合。

exercises.original: The celebration included both close family and more distant relatives.
exercises.zh: 慶祝活動包括直系家人和較遠親屬。
exercises.upgrade: extended family · 大家庭；擴展家庭

options.explanation: household = 不是同住與否的區別。
next of kin = 不適合和 distant relatives 對比。
family circle = 不夠具體。
extended family = close vs more distant relatives 正好對應 immediate vs extended family。
loved ones = 不按親屬遠近分類。
community = 不合。

words.note: 中性、清楚的描述性說法，適合正式和一般語境，強調家庭中的個別成員。
words.example: Family members were asked to provide contact information.
words.exampleZh: 家庭成員被要求提供聯絡資料。

exercises.original: All family must provide emergency contact details.
exercises.zh: 所有家庭成員都必須提供緊急聯絡資料。
exercises.upgrade: family members · 家庭成員；家人

options.explanation: households = 是住戶單位，不是每個人。
relatives = 可能包括不屬該核心家庭的遠親。
family members = 行政語境中逐一指家庭內的人，family members 最清楚。
loved ones = 太主觀。
kin = 語體不自然。
community = 不合。

exercises.original: The nurse explained the care plan to the patient's family.
exercises.zh: 護士向病人的家庭成員解釋照護計劃。
exercises.upgrade: family members · 家庭成員；家人

options.explanation: household = 病人家人未必與其同住。
next of kin = 若只是一名法定聯絡人會更窄。
friends = 不等同 family。
family members = 護士是向多名具體家人說明資訊，因此 family members 最自然。
family unit = 不是個別可溝通的人。
community = 不合。

exercises.original: Family were asked to wait outside during the procedure.
exercises.zh: 家庭成員被要求在程序進行期間在外等候。
exercises.upgrade: family members · 家庭成員；家人

options.explanation: households = 不是一整戶在等候。
relatives = 也可，但 family members 更直接保留原意。
loved ones = 情感語氣不必要。
kin = 較舊式。
family members = 指實際在場的個別家人，用 family members 最清楚。
community = 不合。

words.note: 正式用語，常見於醫療、法律和緊急聯絡表格，指法律或程序上最接近的親屬。
words.example: The hospital contacted his next of kin.
words.exampleZh: 醫院聯絡了他的最近親屬。

exercises.original: The hospital contacted the patient's family after the emergency operation.
exercises.zh: 緊急手術後，醫院聯絡了病人的最近親屬。
exercises.upgrade: next of kin · 最近親屬；法定近親

options.explanation: extended family = 醫院一般不會同時聯絡整個大家庭。
household = 病人可能獨居或與非親屬同住。
loved ones = 過於主觀，不適合正式醫院程序。
next of kin = 醫院正式通知程序中，通常聯絡登記的 next of kin。
family circle = 不合行政流程。
community = 不合。

exercises.original: The form asks for the name and phone number of a family contact.
exercises.zh: 表格要求填寫最近親屬的姓名和電話。
exercises.upgrade: next of kin · 最近親屬；法定近親

options.explanation: family members = 太廣，表格通常要求一名指定聯絡人。
extended family = 不合。
household = 未必要求同住者。
loved one = 太主觀。
next of kin = 正式表格要求法定／主要親屬聯絡資料時，next of kin 是標準用語。
friend = 若可填朋友通常會另寫 emergency contact。

exercises.original: Police informed the family before releasing the person's name publicly.
exercises.zh: 警方在公開姓名前先通知最近親屬。
exercises.upgrade: next of kin · 最近親屬；法定近親

options.explanation: household = 不一定是正式通知對象。
relatives = 範圍太廣，警方通常有指定近親程序。
loved ones = 不適合法定通知術語。
extended family = 不合。
community = 不合。
next of kin = 正式死亡／事故通知常使用 next of kin。

words.note: 較文雅或描述性，指一個人的家人和最親近家庭關係圈。
words.example: The news was kept within the family circle at first.
words.exampleZh: 這個消息最初只在家人圈內流傳。

exercises.original: At first, the news was shared only within the family.
exercises.zh: 消息最初只在家人圈內流傳。
exercises.upgrade: family circle · 家庭圈子；家人圈

options.explanation: household = 如果親屬不全同住，household 太窄。
community = 範圍過大。
next of kin = 只指法定最近親屬。
relatives = 可用但不如 within the family circle 表達封閉私人圈子。
family circle = within + 私人消息流傳，很自然可說 within the family circle。
friends = 不合。

exercises.original: The disagreement remained inside the family for many years.
exercises.zh: 這場爭議多年來一直局限在家人圈內。
exercises.upgrade: family circle · 家庭圈子；家人圈

options.explanation: household = 爭議可能跨不同住處的親屬。
community = 不合私人家庭範圍。
next of kin = 過於制度化。
extended family = 可以涉及大家庭，但本句重點是私人圈子。
friends = 不合。
family circle = 秘密或爭議被限制在私密家庭關係圈中，family circle 很貼切。

exercises.original: She rarely discussed work problems with her family.
exercises.zh: 她很少和家人圈內的人談工作問題。
exercises.upgrade: family circle · 家庭圈子；家人圈

options.explanation: family circle = 若重點是私人家庭圈層，而非列出親戚，family circle 很自然。
household = 不一定只和同住者。
kin = 可以指親族，但語氣較古舊。
community = 不合。
next of kin = 不自然。
relatives = 可用，但 family circle 更強調私人圈層。

words.note: 較正式，強調家庭作為一個共同生活或社會單位，常見於政策、社會學和福利語境。
words.example: The programme is designed to support the family unit during periods of crisis.
words.exampleZh: 這項計劃旨在危機期間支援整個家庭單位。

exercises.original: The programme provides counselling to support the whole family during a crisis.
exercises.zh: 計劃提供輔導，以在危機期間支援整個家庭單位。
exercises.upgrade: family unit · 家庭單位；家庭組合

options.explanation: relatives = 過於分散，未突出共同生活單位。
extended family = 未必包括遠親。
next of kin = 只是一名或少數最近親屬。
loved ones = 不夠政策化。
community = 範圍太大。
family unit = 社會服務把家庭視為共同運作的整體時，family unit 最精確。

exercises.original: Housing instability can place severe pressure on the family.
exercises.zh: 住屋不穩定會對家庭單位造成嚴重壓力。
exercises.upgrade: family unit · 家庭單位；家庭組合

options.explanation: family unit = 住房問題影響整個共同生活和照護結構，因此 family unit 很自然。
relatives = 不是逐個親戚的問題。
kin = 不合社會政策語體。
family circle = 不合。
next of kin = 不合。
community = 範圍太大。

exercises.original: The policy is intended to keep the family together whenever possible.
exercises.zh: 政策旨在盡可能維持家庭單位完整。
exercises.upgrade: family unit · 家庭單位；家庭組合

options.explanation: household = 可重疊，但政策中 family unit 更突出家庭關係整體。
family unit = keep ... together 在社會福利／家庭政策中常以 family unit 表示整體。
relatives = 不自然說 keep relatives together 作制度目標。
loved ones = 太情感化。
next of kin = 不合。
community = 不合。

words.note: 指血緣或家庭關係較近的親屬，範圍通常比 immediate family 稍有彈性。
words.example: Close relatives gathered at the hospital after hearing the news.
words.exampleZh: 近親在得知消息後聚集到醫院。

exercises.original: Only close family were informed before the announcement.
exercises.zh: 公告前只通知了近親。
exercises.upgrade: close relatives · 近親；親近親屬

options.explanation: close relatives = 在正式通知中指關係較近的一群親屬，close relatives 最清楚。
extended family = 範圍可能太廣。
household = 同住者不一定等於 close relatives。
community = 不合。
family unit = 不是個別被通知的人。
friends = 不合 family。

exercises.original: Close family gathered at the hospital after the accident.
exercises.zh: 意外後，近親聚集到醫院。
exercises.upgrade: close relatives · 近親；親近親屬

options.explanation: household = 未必都同住。
close relatives = 多名關係近的親屬到醫院，close relatives 很自然。
next of kin = 通常是一名或少數法定最近親屬。
extended family = 可能包含更遠成員。
family circle = 較抽象。
community = 不合。

exercises.original: The invitation was limited to close family and a few friends.
exercises.zh: 邀請只限近親和幾名朋友。
exercises.upgrade: close relatives · 近親；親近親屬

options.explanation: household = 同住者不是邀請關係標準。
extended family = 通常比 close relatives 更廣。
close relatives = 和 a few friends 並列時，close relatives 清楚表示近親。
loved ones = 可能包含後面的 friends，造成語義重疊。
next of kin = 太正式。
community = 不合。

words.note: 較口語、帶感情色彩，指自己最親近、最珍愛的人，常包括家人和伴侶。
words.example: He celebrated the achievement with his nearest and dearest.
words.exampleZh: 他和最親近的人一起慶祝這項成就。

exercises.original: She celebrated the good news with her closest family and friends.
exercises.zh: 她和最親近的人一起慶祝好消息。
exercises.upgrade: nearest and dearest · 最親近的人；至親

options.explanation: next of kin = 太正式，不適合慶祝語境。
nearest and dearest = 慶祝情境中，對最親近、最珍愛的人可用較口語的 nearest and dearest。
household = 未必只包括同住者。
relatives = 會排除親密朋友／伴侶。
family unit = 太制度化。
community = 太廣。

exercises.original: He wanted his family around him on his birthday.
exercises.zh: 他生日那天希望最親近的人陪在身邊。
exercises.upgrade: nearest and dearest · 最親近的人；至親

options.explanation: household = 未必只想見同住者。
next of kin = 不合生日語境。
nearest and dearest = 生日陪伴重點是情感上的最親近人，因此 nearest and dearest 很自然。
kin = 較舊式且只突出親屬。
family members = 較中性，缺少情感意味。
community = 不合。

exercises.original: The award ceremony was attended by her family and closest friends.
exercises.zh: 頒獎禮有她最親近的人出席。
exercises.upgrade: nearest and dearest · 最親近的人；至親

options.explanation: relatives = 會漏掉 closest friends。
next of kin = 太法律化。
household = 範圍太窄。
nearest and dearest = 原句同時包括 family 和 closest friends，nearest and dearest 可自然概括兩者。
extended family = 仍不包括 friends。
family unit = 不自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 朋友不等於家人 friends 是由個人關係建立的友人；family 通常涉及血緣、婚姻、收養或家庭關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Friends can be very close, but they are not automatically family.

falseSynonyms.zh: 房子不等於家庭 house 是建築物；household 才可表示同住一個住所的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A house is a building; a household is the group of people living in it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 父母只是家庭的一部分 parents 只指父親和母親；family 的範圍通常更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Parents are family members, but they are not the whole family.

falseSynonyms.zh: 子女不等於整個家庭 children 只指子女；family 可包括父母、兄弟姊妹、配偶和其他親屬。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Children may be part of a family, but family is a broader term.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社群不等於家庭 community 是因地點、興趣或身份而形成的群體；family 是更具親屬或家庭關係的群體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A community may contain many families.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字形相近但意思不同 family 是家庭；familiar 表示熟悉的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She visited her family. The neighbourhood looked familiar.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與形容詞不同 family 是名詞；familial 是形容詞，表示與家庭或遺傳家族有關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Family support can be important. Familial relationships can be complex.

falseSynonyms.zh: 親屬與副詞不同 relative 可指親屬；relatively 是副詞，表示相對地。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She invited several relatives. The journey was relatively short.
